name: docs
tagline_zh: 问 Claude 文档，别翻网页了。直接英文提问，生成互动教程和 HTML 更新日志，还能检查本地缓存新不新鲜。
tagline_en: Stop hunting docs. Ask plain-English, get interactive courses, HTML changelogs, and cache freshness checks—all.
desc_en: Router for the /docs command. Look up Claude documentation, ask plain-English questions, generate interactive courses and HTML changelog reports, check freshness, and sync the local cache. Dispatches to the claude-docs, claude-docs-validate, claude-docs-course, and claude-docs-changelog skills.
why_zh: 它把四个文档技能串成一条路由，问完还能自动同步缓存，省掉你手动翻页的笨功夫。
why_en: Routes four doc skills into one flow, auto-syncs cache, and turns queries into courses—no more tab-hopping.
unshelve_reason: 问二 · Anthropic 官方文档镜像，用户自己会去官网；且 disable-model-invocation: true，本质是别人插件的内部分发器。
